The tallest mountain in the world **above sea level** is **Mount Everest**.

* **Elevation:** **8,848.86 meters (29,031.7 feet)** above sea level (officially updated in 2020 by a joint survey between Nepal and China).
* **Location:** The Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas, on the border between Nepal and the Tibet Autonomous Region of China.

*(Note: While **Mauna Kea** in Hawaii is taller when measured from its underwater base on the ocean floor to its peak at ~10,210 meters / 33,500 feet, only 4,207 meters / 13,803 feet of it sits above sea level—making Mount Everest the highest above sea level.)*
